description: This file declares the HostToolTarget class, which provides an interface for managing various host tool binaries and their associated flags within the Cuttlefish project. It specifies methods for retrieving binary names, paths, and flag information, primarily for controlling and querying host tools related to Android emulation.

classes.name: HostToolTarget
classes.description: Provides methods to access and manage host tool binaries and their flag information in the Cuttlefish Android emulator environment.

methods.name: HostToolTarget
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with the given artifacts path, such as ANDROID_HOST_OUT.

methods.name: GetFlagInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific command-line flag for a given binary.

methods.name: GetStartBinName
methods.description: Returns the binary name used to start the host tool.

methods.name: GetStopBinName
methods.description: Returns the binary name used to stop the host tool.

methods.name: GetStatusBinName
methods.description: Returns the binary name used to check the status of the host tool.

methods.name: GetRestartBinPath
methods.description: Returns the full path to the restart binary.

methods.name: GetPowerwashBinPath
methods.description: Returns the full path to the powerwash binary.

methods.name: GetPowerBtnBinPath
methods.description: Returns the full path to the power button binary.

methods.name: GetSnapshotBinName
methods.description: Returns the binary name for snapshot operations.

methods.name: GetBinName
methods.description: Helper method to select the correct binary name from a list of alternatives.
